subject: general
question: When was air transport nationalised in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1953**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Air transport was nationalized in India in the year **1953**.
 
• The Government of India passed the **Air Corporations Act, 1953**, which led to the nationalization of the airline industry.
 
• Two new corporations, **Air India International** and **Indian Airlines**, were established to handle international and domestic air services, respectively.
 
• This move was aimed at ensuring better management, safety, and growth of the aviation sector in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Air Corporations Act, 1953**, was repealed in 1994, paving the way for private airlines to operate in India.
 
• Before nationalization, there were several private airlines operating in India, including Tata Airlines, which later became Air India.
 
• Nationalization helped in standardizing operations and improving the safety record of Indian aviation.
 
• Today, the Indian aviation sector is a mix of public and private enterprises, with numerous domestic and international players.
